title: Welcome to FIKRADO News
excerpt: A new place for company announcements, course updates, and security write-ups from the FIKRADO Security team.
content:
We have started publishing news here so you can follow what we are building.

Expect updates on:

- New cybersecurity and technology courses
- Free learning material and video tutorials
- Security advisories and practical write-ups
- Company news from Hargeisa and Jijiga

This page is maintained by the FIKRADO Security team. If you have a question about anything published here, get in touch through the contact page.

title: Course Updates Across the Horn of Africa
excerpt: Sample post showing how course announcements appear on the News page.
content:
This is a sample post included so the News page can be reviewed with realistic content before real announcements are published.
